name: meterit
description: Full-stack device tracking application with dual-deployment architecture

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -t -p "[{name}]" -n client-api,client-frontend,sync-api,sync-mcp,sync-frontend -c "yellowBright,cyanBright,blueBright,magentaBright,greenBright" "npm run client:api" "npm run client:frontend" "npm run sync:api" "npm run sync:mcp" "npm run sync:frontend"
scripts.dev:client: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -t -p "[{name}]" -n client-api,client-frontend -c "yellowBright,cyanBright" "npm run client:api" "npm run client:frontend"
scripts.dev:sync: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -t -p "[{name}]" -n sync-api,sync-mcp,sync-frontend -c "blueBright,magentaBright,greenBright" "npm run sync:api" "npm run sync:mcp" "npm run sync:frontend"
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd client/api && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../../sync/api && npm install && cd ../mcp && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build:client: cd framework/frontend && npm install && cd ../../client/frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:sync: cd sync/frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:sync
scripts.build:sync:all: npm run build:sync:api && npm run build:sync:mcp && npm run build:sync:frontend
scripts.test:all: concurrently -n client-api,client-fe,sync-api,sync-mcp,framework-fe,sync-fe -c "yellow,cyan,blue,magenta,greenBright,white" "cd client/api && npm test" "cd client/frontend && npm run test:run" "cd sync/api && npm test" "cd sync/mcp && npm test" "cd framework/frontend && npm run test:run" "cd sync/frontend && npm run test:run"
scripts.lint: concurrently -n client-fe,sync-fe -c "cyan,green" "cd client/frontend && npm run lint" "cd sync/frontend && npm run lint"
scripts.typecheck: concurrently -n client-api,client-fe,sync-api,sync-mcp,sync-fe -c "yellow,cyan,blue,magenta,green" "cd client/api && npm run type-check" "cd client/frontend && npm run type-check" "cd sync/api && npm run type-check" "cd sync/mcp && npm run type-check" "cd sync/frontend && npm run type-check"
